job.job_description:
We Are
At Synopsys, we drive innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence-from selfdriving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of highperformance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
You Are
A highly skilled and technically strong Lead Validation Engineer with deep expertise in Static Timing Analysis (STA) and PrimeTime flows. You are comfortable owning complex validation areas endtoend, mentoring engineers, driving validation strategy, and acting as a technical bridge between Product Validation, RD, Product Engineering, and Field teams.
You proactively identify risk areas, influence design decisions through datadriven insights, leverage modern AIassisted engineering tools to improve efficiency and depth, and uphold the highest standards of product quality and validation rigor.
What You'll Be Doing Technical Leadership Validation Ownership
Lead and own validation of complex PrimeTime STA features and flows, from requirement analysis through quality signoff.
Define and drive validation strategy, depth, and coverage for assigned functional areas.
Act as technical lead for L1/L2 engineers, providing guidance on STA concepts, debugging approaches, testcase design, and best practices.
Review and approve validation plans, testcases, regression results, and quality signoff metrics.
Product Quality, Debug, and CrossTeam Collaboration
Drive customer scenario reproduction, deepdive debugging, and rootcause analysis of complex, crosscomponent issues.
Proactively identify product weak areas, corner cases, and scalability/performance risks and ensure early detection.
Work closely with RD, Product Engineering, and Field teams to clarify requirements, influence design decisions, validate fixes, and ensure smooth integration.
Lead functional, regression, stress, accuracy, and signofforiented testing for STA features and advanced flows.
Automation, Data Analysis AIAssisted Productivity
Architect and enhance automation frameworks using Perl, Tcl, and Python to improve productivity, robustness, and validation coverage.
Analyze largescale validation and regression data to identify trends, systemic gaps, and improvement opportunities.
Effectively leverage AIassisted engineering tools (e.g., VS Code / Cursorbased workflows with multiple LLMs) for:
Faster testcase and automation script development
Debug acceleration and hypothesis generation
Log analysis, flow understanding, and code reviews
Improving documentation quality and consistency
Apply sound technical judgment to validate, review, and refine AIassisted outputs, ensuring correctness, accuracy, and compliance with quality standards.
Communication Continuous Improvement
Prepare and present clear, executiveready validation status, quality metrics, risks, and recommendations.
Participate in feature readiness reviews, postmortems, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Drive best practices in validation methodology, tooling, and knowledge sharing across the team.
The Impact You Will Have
Own and drive quality signoff for critical PrimeTime STA features.
Significantly reduce customerreported issues through proactive, riskbased validation.
Improve tool accuracy, robustness, scalability, and realworld customer readiness.
Strengthen crossteam alignment by serving as a trusted technical Subject Matter Expert (SME).
Elevate overall team capability through mentorship, technical leadership, and adoption of modern productivity tools.
Influence product roadmap and feature decisions through validationdriven insights.
What You'll Need
Strong, handson understanding of Static Timing Analysis fundamentals.
BSEE with 5+ years of relevant experience OR MSEE with 4+ years of relevant experience.
Deep handson experience with:
Synopsys PrimeTime or equivalent STA tools
Advanced timing concepts, SDC constraints, and realworld signoff scenarios
OCV/AOCV/POCV, derates, PBA, ECO, and whatif analysis flows
Hierarchical, distributed, and largescale STA flows
Proven ability to debug complex, ambiguous, crosscomponent issues.
Strong proficiency in Perl, Tcl, and Python for automation and framework development.
Experience using AIassisted development tools responsibly to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality.
Track record of technical ownership, leadership, and sound decisionmaking.
High standards for quality, rigor, documentation, and signoff discipline.
Locations
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
